_manifestNotes.runtime: Manifest-driven RPG Maker MV HTML5/native, Godot HTML5/native, and LibGDX/LWJGL native games
_manifestNotes.gamePackageFormat: Per-game packageFormat: mv-html5-www; mv-windows-deployment; windows-game-folder; gradle-project; godot-html5; libgdx-html5.
_manifestNotes.wwwReplacementRule: For mv-html5-www, the downloaded www folder replaces the existing installed www folder. For mv-windows-deployment, the complete deployment folder replaces the managed game install contents after backup.
howToAddNewGame: Copy the _gameTemplate object into the games array and assign a unique id.
Set runtimeType and packageFormat for the game's exported package; do not point at a Gradle source project unless its distribution output is packaged for launch.
For RPG Maker MV HTML5 use runtimeType mvhtml5 and packageFormat mv-html5-www with www/index.html.
For a complete RPG Maker MV Windows deployment use runtimeType mv-exe and packageFormat mv-windows-deployment with Game.exe plus its NW.js package/runtime files.
For native Godot Windows exports use runtimeType godot and packageFormat godot-windows (or windows-game-folder); set launchExecutable to the exported .exe and include companion .pck files.
For Godot HTML5 exports use runtimeType godot and packageFormat godot-html5; ZIP should contain index.html and the exported wasm/pck/assets files.

For LibGDX/LWJGL Windows distributions use runtimeType libgdx or lwjgl and packageFormat libgdx-windows, lwjgl-windows, windows-game-folder, or gradle-project (a packaged Gradle wrapper project); set launchExecutable to a .exe, .bat, .cmd, or .jar in the packaged distribution.

For native games set launchExecutable relative to the deployment root. Optional launchArguments, workingDirectory, and javaExecutable, javaMainClass, and javaClasspath configure arguments, current directory, and Java/classpath for .jar packages.
Native game ZIPs may contain one enclosing folder; TSBCPlay locates the configured launchExecutable and stages the complete sibling deployment folder.
Add files verification entries using safe relative paths from the installed game root.
gamePathRules: Each game uses its own install root derived dynamically from its manifest id: Games\{gameId}.
MV HTML5 packages must contain www/index.html beneath that game's install root.
Godot HTML5 packages use their exported index.html and asset files in the managed install root.
Native deployments use the configured launchExecutable and retain companion files in the managed install root.
runtimeModes: html5 games use TSBCPlay WebView2 with the installed www/index.html.
mv-exe games launch the complete configured MV Windows deployment.
godot native games launch the manifest launchExecutable with companion .pck/assets; Godot HTML5 games run through the integrated WebView2 host.

libgdx/lwjgl native games launch the manifest launchExecutable; .jar packages use Java -jar by default or Java -cp when javaMainClass/javaClasspath are configured, and .bat/.cmd packages run through cmd.exe.
